_doc: Revert-verify mutant for the PRE-CHECK half of issue #4469 / req 2d072437-c19d-49a4-ae89-f20b6185571f. `claimTask` refuses a task already claimed by another worker; that refusal is decided by `readFrontmatter`, which carried its own LF/CRLF-only regex while the WRITE it guards (`atomicUpdateFrontmatter`) was widened by this work item. MC1 restores the local regex — the refusal branch then becomes unreachable for a lone-CR / BOM task file and the claim is silently STOLEN from its owner. Expectations written BEFORE the run.
